NEGATIVE for the single-link linear-chain reading; link assignment itself is the open model input (gated on R5-full SDP #604). Scope-(a).

verdict: Two-layer verdict. (i) NOT DECISIVELY TESTABLE: the corpus fixes no derived 4He binding link (canonical knot-ID gated on R5-full SDP, #604; the A<=3 IDs are deprecated volume-search matches), so the link assignment is the open MODEL INPUT. (ii) Scope-(a) NEGATIVE for the pre-registered structural reading: the exact AME back-out gives Vol4 = 8.0484 (confirming the pre-registered 8.048), and NO in-advance-named candidate matches within even the +/-0.31 model band — linear 4-chains L8a21/L8a20 at 10.149 (+26%), brunnian analogue non-hyperbolic (Vol~0), L8n7 = Vol(Borromean) = 7.328 (-0.72), L8a19 at 10.667. The naive 'n=4 term = single linear-chain-closure volume' reading FAILS at 4He. This constrains that single-link reading only: the Lean-proved multiplicity (n-1), the 3H -0.16% / 3He -2.97% results, and the tower form survive. Guarded census datum: the implied volume falls in a GAP of the 4-component HT census spectrum (<=14 crossings) — 0 links within +/-0.05, only 2 within the model band (nearest at +/-0.31/0.34) — so no <=14-crossing 4-component link carries Vol4 even post-hoc; and any wider post-hoc volume search would be a CAL-4 fit, out of bounds. Honest routes: R5-full SDP canonical knot-ID at H12, or a non-single-volume n=4 term. No fit; nothing wired.
scope: (a) — constrains the single-link n=4 reading; multiplicity + A=3 + tower form untouched
